status_scope: Local synthetic checks of the retained workflow guards only; no GitHub execution, deployment, credential or teardown claim.

source.unchanged_input: .github/workflows/cleanup.yml from the base, retained as cleanup.yml.txt
source.unrelated_workspace_changes: Concurrent document and budget overlays are outside this proof; the harness reads only the two retained workflows.

procedure: Parse actual workflow YAML through Schema, then execute its guard and comment scripts in Node VM contexts with synthetic events, environment variables and GitHub API responses.
Check the JavaScript-compatible workflow expression subset, shared cleanup concurrency, bounded stage transport, teardown outcomes and shell syntax.
Typecheck the retained harness under strict settings.

commands.typecheck: bunx --no-install tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --skipLibCheck --strict --target ES2024 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --types bun ./work/ci-proof/manual-preview/guard.test.ts

observed_result.typecheck_log: Empty on successful exit; exit code observed by the operator.

limitations: Synthetic GitHub responses and event contexts; no GitHub API call, hosted runner, Cloudflare command or remote state access occurred.
Expression evaluation covers only the workflow JavaScript-compatible subset; this is not a GitHub service emulator.
This record does not retain or claim the seven separate root repository checks.
Gate variables are job snapshots. Queued and running jobs must be drained before changing admission.
Restore the archived harness to its original scratch path and the retained workflows to their paths in a disposable checkout of the base to reproduce. A new execution requires a new evidence attempt.
